verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a downloadable OpenAPI document at developers.cloudflare.com/openapi.json, and the docs describe a Registrar API for searching, checking, registering, and managing domains. However, nothing shows that this platform-wide spec actually includes the Registrar endpoints or that it is documented as a Registrar-specific download, so coverage of this story is only partial. missing for 10: evidence that the OpenAPI spec includes the Registrar endpoints, first-party docs pointing users to the spec download, independent or hands-on corroboration of using the spec for Registrar.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://developers.cloudflare.com/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
Registrar API for searching, checking, registering, and managing domains through Cloudflare Registrar.
